requestPipeline.step: HTTP request received by Nginx / Swoole / FrankenPHP / Sail
requestPipeline.detail: Web server routes all requests to public/index.php bootstrap file.

requestPipeline.step: Laravel Kernel bootstraps application providers & middleware stack
requestPipeline.detail: Registers service providers, loads .env config, and initializes HTTP Kernel.

requestPipeline.step: Route matched by Laravel Router (Web / API / Filament Panel)
requestPipeline.detail: Route pattern matched against URL parameters. Controller or Livewire component resolved.

requestPipeline.step: Sanctum / Session auth middleware verifies identity
requestPipeline.detail: Auth guard checks Bearer token (API) or session cookie (Admin/Customer Panel). 401 on failure.

requestPipeline.step: Filament Shield / Policy Gate checks user authorization
requestPipeline.detail: @can or Spatie permission checked against user roles. 403 Forbidden on failure.
Incoming payload validated against rules. Fails with 422 Unprocessable Content if invalid.

requestPipeline.step: Controller / Livewire action executes business logic
requestPipeline.detail: Service logic invoked. Model events and database transactions triggered.

requestPipeline.step: Eloquent ORM / Spatie QueryBuilder executes database queries
requestPipeline.detail: SQL queries generated with eager loading. Query results mapped to Model instances.

requestPipeline.step: Response formatted — Blade/Livewire DOM update or JSON Resource returned
requestPipeline.detail: API Resource serializes model to JSON (200 OK) or Livewire updates reactive DOM diff.

errorPipeline: Unhandled Exception thrown in Controller, Service, or Policy
Exception mapped to HTTP status code (400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 422 Validation Error, 500 Internal Error)
Formatted JSON response or Filament error notification displayed to user
